title: Infinity
tagline: AI Agent for small business owners to automate customer loyalty/promotional programs.
description:
Image owning a remote food truck; you want to quickly run a promotional offer (i.e. free taco) to attract and reward loyal customers, but have limited resources and time to make it happen.  

Introducing the Infinity AI Agent—small businesses are now a chat away from automated loyalty/promotional offer campaigns that can run from anywhere, anytime! Owners can now manage their promotional offers and loyalty programs through the subscription-based platform which can be accessed through a computer or phone. 

With just a few steps, business owners set up offers through an Agent chat interface that collects basic details to set up the promotional offer. The Agent creates the campaign; writes some social media posts to kick it off; and automates the distribution, tracking, and redemption of the offers directly with customers. In turn, customers can receive offers directly with their wallet and quickly redeem them digitally when they claim their promotional offer. 

Infinity also tracks and monitors the promotional offer/loyalty program campaign budgets and user engagement so businesses can understand the marketing impact with relevant data, and adjust campaigns as needed. 

Infinity AI Agent is the future of loyalty programs: on-chain and automated, anywhere at anytime, easy-to-use and set-it-and-forget-it!
how_its_made:
Using Blockchain, Eliza AI, and NFT technology, we have created an easy-to-use AI Agent for businesses so they can focus on running the core operations of their business and interacting directly with customers. 

Blockchain technology allows us to build a foundation for quick and instant digital payments and digital coupons: 

- Business:
    - Subscribe to Infinity AaaS with a wallet (new to Web3 owners can instantly create a wallet through social login, or an existing wallet can be connected).
    - Fund AI Agent wallet gas fees (as relevant).
- Agent:
    - Receive funding through the business owner’s wallet.
    - Parse customer wallets from business payments wallet transactions to create a database of customer wallet addresses and note points by spend. Then the agent can note if customers have enough points for a promotional offer and identify which wallets to send the promotional offer to accordingly.
    - Create a separate Agent wallet to manage NFT minting and burning directly with customer wallets, and track points balance reduction after customer claims an offer.
- Customer:
    - Receive NFT promotional offer coupon from the Agent (after paying with cryptocurrency to business payments wallet QR Code and earning sufficient points).
    - Connect wallet to webpage where they can quickly redeem their NFT to claim their promotional offer.

Eliza AI allows us to create an advanced AI agent that compiles multiple tasks into one AI framework without having to set up an ecosystem of task-based agents. Eliza gives us a more advanced platform to start from and ability to program more complex (but still connected) tasks. 

- Promo Set-Up:
    - AI consolidates the campaign information into actionable items and also creates them on-demand: smart contract, NFT, campaign-specific social media content, QR Code.
    - AI also allows us to configure multiple APIs across fields to execute actions on the owner’s behalf.
- Program Automation:
    - AI monitors the merchant wallet address income to distribute tokens, which work as points in a tamper-proof customer loyalty system.
    - AI scans customer requirements and automatically approves NFT/offer redemption based on specific criteria set by the business (i.e. social media follow, minimum amount of prior spend).
- Data Insights:
    - AI is especially beneficial in distilling valuable insights through the gathering and visualization of data over time, which enables owners to optimize campaigns to be more effective without spending the time on complex data analytics.

NFTs allow us to create digital coupons that can be quickly created with images and without printing. These digital coupons can be sent directly to customers and then redeemed automatically by the Agent after customers meet pre-set criteria, making it a hassle-free and hands-free experience for Owners.

Other - API for QR Code: Agent creates an HTML QR Code for customers to scan (if needed) and land on a webpage.

We are using technology for real world use cases and real world users. Let's bring the world on-chain!
